purpose: Exact replacements to shorten article-dependent public copy; preserve public original analyses, comparison gaps, questions, source limits and all other-source material.
applicationInstructions: Assert old value before every JSON pointer replacement; abort on mismatch.
Apply only replacements, then run the normal collection/registry/content/app generation. Never patch generated app/public/registry JSON directly.
Re-read generated source notes: all aliases for this URL must contain the common note without retained older synonyms. Source-specific limits remain visible.
Rebuild the sentence inventory after applying; compare with countedSentences. If new wording appears, count it instead of relying on this proposed total.

The generated alias source-b39935309e4b1397b825 inherits the old small-systems source note; regeneration must clear that old synonym. Do not remove the original public company engineering analyses or questions listed in excludedPublicText.

method.normalization: Unicode NFC; collapse whitespace; split only after ., !, ?, 。 followed by whitespace, and at newlines.
method.deduplication: Exact normalized sentence equality across aliases, fields and screen/print; no semantic deduplication.
method.unit: Whitespace-delimited Korean eojeol, preserving intentional internal spaces in 105MM ABC SYSTEM etc.
method.included: All article-dependent narrative claims, narrative form/limitations (even original limits), shared public source notes, source-dependent company statements/mixed-source observations, four other companies exhibition facts/forms, existing five image captions.
method.excluded: IDs/URLs/metadata titles/names; original engineering interpretations, audit methods and questions listed individually; explicit other-source content; image-rights/capture-date audit metadata. Exclusions stay public and are not moved to internal fields.
method.notClaimed: This is not an all-visible-text length limit. The previous all-associated-field upper bounds were 738 words for 3 companies and 1015 for 7 companies, including original questions and unrelated-source text. Those are not source-derivative totals.
